newsitem.title: EGYPT: Floods damage houses in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Floods damage houses in southern Egypt.

text.p: Floods from rain in the Red Sea hills have damaged hundreds of houses and cut off about 300 families near the south Egyptian town of Aswan, local government officials said on Sunday.
Water from the wadis running down towards the Nile has also flooded the workshops of the Railways Board, spilling 10 tonnes of oil and petrol onto the land nearby, they said.
The areas worst affected are about two km (one mile) north of the town but the floods have also cut off the electricity supply and some telephones in the town. No one has been hurt.
The rains, the heaviest in Aswan since 1979, began on Wednesday and continued on Sunday.
